text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One claimed victory in the Mainichi 
Okan. However, she trembled at the 
overwhelming pressure radiating from Oguri 
Cap, who had run alongside her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, overhearing the spectators' 
conversations after the race made her 
realize that her current running was still 
far from proving the greatness of everyone 
in Oi.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her next goal, the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), just around the corner, Inari 
One was overtaken by anxiety that she 
might miss out on Horse of the Year.
